commits.slice: Specification, immutable raw/index replay records, exact resolver endpoint membership
One-read acquisition, versioned consent/evidence, immutable workspace/project raw objects, pre-create checks
Offline CLI replay, backup acceptance, legacy/future-version handling, pre-resume and conflicting-copy guards

gap_evidence: Base WorkspaceFileIndex discarded original bytes after parsing, and acquire used separate resolver and delivery reads.
Base AcquisitionEvidence retained normalized rows and entry digests only; it had no raw object or complete resolver arguments/membership.
Base older-row selection explicitly refused repeated SHA bodies because predecessor membership was unavailable.
SPEC-31-D and tasks/todo.md explicitly left original raw index retention and resolver-input replay open.
Relevant unmerged acquire/evidence/resolver/wiring/parser path history and the prior donor missing-file census yielded no reusable raw-replay implementation. No donor merge was performed.
acceptance: Exact original plain/gzip bytes retained separately from bounded JSON evidence.
One held source read supplies resolver inputs and both delivery endpoint choices.
Consent binds raw SHA/length, metadata, complete input/result digests, losses, resolver arguments and actual endpoint membership.
Repeated older SHA across different KBs uses its actual predecessor; conflicting same-priority copies remain refused and native bodies retain precedence.
Original and potential-expanded row budgets are enforced before lineage expansion; multi-file preview captures have aggregate byte/row budgets.
Owned publication refuses foreign, aliased and damaged objects without replacement; failed workspace retention precedes staging.
Retained source is checked before project creation or journal resume mutation.
Repair works without mutable index records, and backup replay works after original workspace/project deletion.
Historical v1 evidence/v2 consent serialization and identities remain unchanged; no raw provenance is invented.
Offline replay fails explicitly for missing, damaged, foreign-project or nonreproducing data; future processing versions are unsupported.

observed_runs.reason: Incorrect authored fixture expectations: one rejected body and actual predecessor KB5098000; corrected from actual fixture/source.
Existing adversarial fixtures hardcoded evidence v1 IDs or faulted all publication; updated to actual version and original project fault seam.
Exact wiring allowlist did not yet permit existing owned read_bytes; added a second exact tuple plus rejection controls.
Authored test expected exit 2; existing PT-KBC-LIMIT maps to exit 3. Runtime exit contract unchanged.
Created journal advanced to partial after damaged retained source. Verification moved before resume mutation.
New raw membership path initially admitted first conflicting copied body; fixed to preserve original ambiguity refusal and native precedence.

limits_and_remaining_gates: All exercised provider data and PE inputs were synthetic; transport was injected and sockets denied.
No target binary execution, live Winbindex/symbol-server fetch, native Windows publication test, remote write or broad donor merge occurred.
Independent review, exact-source hosted full suite and native/package release qualification belong to the parent integration task.
Replay establishes retained-byte and resolver consistency, not Microsoft authorship, signature validity, vulnerability attribution or L1/L2/L3 accuracy.
